international.title: US admits ‘substantial’ change to extradition request translation for leftist activist
international.summary: DoJ cites three examples of alterations from English into Spanish for James ‘Fergie’ Chambers after Guardian report US authorities have admitted altering the translation of an extradition request for James “Fergie” Chambers from English into Spanish, attributing violent and illegal actions to the wealthy activist and philanthropist that were not in the original. Chambers’s case is the first known instance of the US seeking to extradite a citizen over alleged support for Hamas, an accusation apparently tied to an international money laundering charge in the criminal complaint underpinning the extradition request and donations to organizations helping Palestinians in Gaza.
